column2: (1) Where a person who is not a citizen of Sri Lanka

column1: is arrested for an offence under this Act, such person shall be

column2: to  communicate  without  delay  with  the  nearest
appropriate representative of the State of which he
is a national or which is otherwise entitled to protect
his rights or if he is a stateless person, with the nearest
appropriate representative of the State in the territory
where he was habitually resident; and
to be visited by a representative of that State.
